text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Yasuda Kinen: Daiichi Ruby takes 1st 
place. Daitaku Helios celebrates her 
victory, but—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In Daiichi Ruby's eyes, there was only the 
path of what she must be as part of the 
"Clan." Total cold shoulder.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next goal is the Mile CS. I should get 
to race Daiichi Ruby again! Time to build 
up my vibes until then!
